21:40 local, 16:40 GMT, 22:10 IST: Once again, it was the same trio that made the difference between the two sides. With the bat, Maaz Sadaqat and Sahibzada Farhan set the tone, while Mohammad Imran Randhawa led the charge with the ball. After smashing 84 in the final six overs, Pakistan carried all the momentum into the second innings and made full use of it, by picking up four wickets in eight overs. Sri Lanka needed a strong powerplay to have any chance of chasing down this mammoth total, but they struggled to get going, managing just 35 runs and playing far too many dot balls. The hosts were disciplined with their lengths and used their variations to great effect, sealing a comprehensive win to clinch the series with a game to go. Stick around for the post-match reactions!

Maaz Sadaqat | Player of the Match: [On his form today compared to the last game] Thanks to Almighty first. The way my bat was flowing, I was trying to make the most of it, it was a good innings. [On telling Hasan Nawaz in advance that he would hit a six] Absolutely. I believed in myself and knew I could hit it. So I told him beforehand that I would hit a six off that ball and asked him to watch, that’s exactly what happened. [On his positive intent when he walks out to bat] I always have that positive intent from the start. The other thing is that I watch the ball and try to hit it according to where it is pitched. That’s what brings me success. [On his partnership with the captain] He was guiding me ball by ball, and we were communicating with each other about what was happening in each over, whether there were opportunities to take it easy or hit boundaries. Accordingly, we decided when not to go for big shots. We were both trying to build a long innings together. [Translated from Urdu]
